cohort: The study participants were 428 mothers who delivered (85 cases of stillbirth and 343 controls) at selected public hospitals in the West Shoa Zone, Oromia, Ethiopia.
finding: Preeclampsia/eclampsia, other maternal health conditions, mal-presentation, umbilical cord accidents, meconium-stained amniotic fluid problems, low birth weight, and referral status were identified as independent determinants of stillbirth.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was identified as a determinant of stillbirth.
